channel.title: Los Gatos Dispatch
channel.description: Los Gatos, Saratoga and Campbell news, once a week, from the Los Gatos Dispatch.

item.title: Saratoga lights its holiday tree in Blaney Plaza on Friday, November 27, at 5:30 PM
item.description: The city's calendar lists the lighting from 5:30 to 6:30 PM in the plaza in the Historic Saratoga Village, as the start of the Village's holiday season.

item.title: Los Gatos and Monte Sereno want residents' answers on wildfire evacuation by December 12
item.description: The two are drafting an emergency evacuation plan with the planning consultant Dudek, and a short survey asks about evacuation needs and concerns.

item.title: Crews are clearing brush up to 20 feet from the edge of 31.09 miles of Los Gatos hillside roads
item.description: The work, paid for by USDA and FEMA wildfire grants, started November 2 and should take three to four months, weather permitting, generally 8 AM to 4 PM; it also clears 13 feet 6 inches above the road.

item.title: Campbell starts heavy leaf sweeping on 52 streets on November 25
item.description: , running to the beginning of January.

item.title: Los Gatos is filling seats on ten boards and commissions; applications close Monday, November 23, at 5 PM
item.description: The list includes the Planning Commission, the Complete Streets & Transportation Commission and the Library Board.

item.title: sandbags before the next storm
item.description: Both towns hand out sandbags for the winter.
